Xianzhun %1$s
Native offline guitar tuner and metronome. A4 = 440 Hz.
Project maintainer: GitHub account lj5201lj. No account, ads or analytics SDK.
Store operator details are not yet supplied; this build is not a store-approved release.

1. Choose your tuning, then tap Start tuning and allow the microphone.
2. Pluck ONE open string. The large note is detected pitch; the target row is the selected or nearest string. In Auto mode the string is only an estimate.
3. Adjust slowly. Negative cents is flat; positive is sharp; ±5 cents is in tune. Verify the string and octave before tightening. A guitar string can break if overtightened.

Tap a string for a 1-second guitar tone. Detection pauses during playback and briefly waits for its tail. Pluck after Listening appears. This is not full acoustic echo cancellation; avoid external or Bluetooth speakers.

Grey/held readings are old, not a live confirmation. If no note appears, try Mic self-test and check input level. Haptic confirmation requires at least 650 ms of continuous in-tune readings, and can be disabled in About.

App %1$s · Android %2$s\nFeedback opens GitHub in your browser; it may require a GitHub account. Issues are public: do not post recordings or private information. Nothing is sent automatically. Copy diagnostics only copies the app/OS version and a blank problem template to your clipboard.
